mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM subscription WHERE parent_user_id=#{user} AND (status='RENEWAL_FAILED' OR (status='ACTIVE' AND auto_renew) OR period_end >= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date)
SELECT count(*) FROM refund_request r JOIN payment p ON p.id=r.payment_id JOIN payment_order o ON o.id=p.order_id WHERE o.parent_user_id=#{user} AND r.status IN ('REQUESTED','APPROVED','FAILED')
